description: Electro is the third Element the Traveler acquires by resonating with the Statue of The Seven in Inazuma .
role_summary: Electro is the third Element the Traveler acquires by resonating with the Statue of The Seven in Inazuma .

talents.name: Foreign Thundershock
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Lightning Blade
talents.description: Unleashes three swift thunder shadows that deal Electro DMG to opponents and leave an Abundance Amulet behind after hitting an opponent. 2 Abundance Amulets can be created initially. Using this skill will reset any Abundance Amulets that were generated. Abundance Amulets When a character is near an Abundance Amulet, they will absorb it and obtain the following effects: Restores Elemental Energy Increases Energy Recharge during the Abundance Amulet's duration.

talents.name: Bellowing Thunder
talents.description: You call upon the protection of lightning, knocking nearby opponents back and dealing Electro DMG to them. Lightning Shroud When your active character's Normal or Charged Attacks hit opponents, they will call Falling Thunder forth, dealing Electro DMG . When Falling Thunder hits opponents, it will regenerate Energy for that character. One instance of Falling Thunder can be generated every 0.5s.

talents.name: Thunderflash
talents.description: When another nearby character in the party obtains an Abundance Amulet created by Lightning Blade , Lightning Blade's CD is decreased by 1.5s.

talents.name: Resounding Roar
talents.description: Increases the Energy Recharge effect granted by Lightning Blade 's Abundance Amulet by 10% of the Traveler's Energy Recharge.

talents.name: Foreign Thundertrail
talents.description: Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs Additional Buff Effects The Traveler gains an attribute bonus for every element they have resonated with: Anemo : CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, Geo : DEF is increased by 20%, Electro : Energy Recharge is increased by 20%, Dendro : Elemental Mastery is increased by 60, Hydro : HP is increased by 20%, Pyro : ATK is increased by 20%, Cryo : CRIT DMG is increased by 20%. . In addition, when nearby party members unleash an Elemental Burst , Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Resounding Thunder, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Resounding Thunder, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Resounding Thunder and transform into the special Charged Attack: Detonate . Charged Attack: Detonate Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Electro DMG . Increase in DMG is equal to 100% of Traveler's ATK. 3s after hitting the enemy, 1 additional lightning strike will be triggered, dealing Electro DMG equal to 200% of Traveler's ATK. 1 Abundance Amulet will also be created. c1.name: Spring Thunder of Fertility
c1.effect: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using Lightning Blade is increased to 3.

c2.name: Violet Vehemence
c2.effect: When Falling Thunder created by Bellowing Thunder hits an opponent, it will decrease their Electro RES by 15% for 8s.

c3.name: Distant Crackling
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Bellowing Thunder by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
c4.effect: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by Lightning Blade , if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

c5.name: Clamor in the Wilds
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Lightning Blade by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: World-Shaker
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by Bellowing Thunder will significantly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, dealing 200% of its original DMG, and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character. The buff applies to every third Falling Thunder attack. The damage increase granted by this Constellation is a multiplicative increase to Falling Thunder DMG, separate from Damage Bonus , and does not affect Additive DMG .
